title: 第7章 箭支升级第8章 菜地鸡舍与围墙
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地
content_zh:
;;
“大哥，你来看，咱们的深乌箭都已经坏了。”
沈鸢将昨夜射杀灯笼鬼的三十二支深乌箭回收起来，只见每一根深乌箭都已经失去了色泽，并且箭身出现不少裂痕。
如今的破坏力估计都跟普通木箭相差无几。
俨然是无法再用了。
沈易面色如常。
箭支本来就是消耗品。
特别是用于对付精怪一类，武器品质不够的话，精怪随意吐口气都能够将攻击它们的武器震碎。
深乌箭归根到底只是用蕴含了一丝阳气的深乌木所制成。
能够用于猎杀灯笼鬼，已经算是很不错了。
“没有深乌箭，我们就不能继续猎杀灯笼鬼了。”
沈坤语气低沉，顿了顿，向沈易提议道：“大哥，不如我们去村里的狩猎队问问，看他们有没有多余的深乌箭。”
“眼下先别和村里人接触。”
沈易摇头。
村里的人相互之间并非铁板一块，个个都有自己的小算盘。
父母先前在村里算是小有名气的修行者，对村子也做出了一定的贡献。
但在他们离世后，黑山村的人对他们三兄妹丝毫没有接济的想法。
尤其是孙闻坑骗他们兄妹一头四百斤近乎化妖的野猪肉这件事，村里的人显然是不会不知情，却无人为他们说话。
想起父母曾经认真叮嘱的话。
在这个世界上，绝对不能够相信任何人，唯有自己才是最靠得住的。

所以沈易对于黑山村的人，警惕心已经提高到了极点。
在没有正式成为修行者之前，他不会轻易接触村里的人。
至于深乌箭的问题……
沈易随手将一支深乌箭拿入手中。
【深乌箭·0级】
【功能：可对一阶精怪造成伤害】
【特性：无】
【耐久值：0100】
……
耐久值果然降到了最低。
沈易心头惋惜，不过下一刻，他立即对彻底损坏的深乌箭进行升级。
唰——

"Brother, come and see, our Shenwu arrows are all broken."
Shen Yuan recovered the thirty-two dark black arrows that killed the lantern ghost last night, and saw that every dark black arrow had lost its color, and there were many cracks in the arrow body.
Today's destructive power is estimated to be almost the same as ordinary wooden arrows.
It seems that it can no longer be used.
Shen Yi's expression remained as usual.
Arrows are inherently consumables.
It is especially used to deal with spirits. If the quality of the weapons is not good enough, the spirits can shatter the weapons attacking them with just a breath.
In the final analysis, the Deep Black Arrow is just made of dark ebony wood that contains a trace of Yang energy.
It can be used to hunt lantern ghosts, which is already very good.
"Without the Deep Black Arrow, we can't continue to hunt the Lantern Ghost."
Shen Kun spoke in a low tone, paused, and suggested to Shen Yi: "Brother, why don't we go to the hunting team in the village and ask if they have any extra Shenwu arrows."
"Don't have any contact with the villagers for now."
Shen Yi shook his head.
People in the village are not monolithic with each other, and everyone has their own little calculations.
My parents were relatively well-known practitioners in the village and made certain contributions to the village.
But after their deaths, the people in Heishan Village had no idea of ​​helping the three brothers and sisters.
Especially when Sun Wenkeng deceived his brother and sister into buying a 400-pound almost demonic wild boar meat, the people in the village were obviously not unaware of it, but no one spoke for them.
I remember what my parents once said seriously.
In this world, you can never trust anyone, only yourself is the most reliable.
Therefore, Shen Yi was extremely vigilant towards the people in Heishan Village.
Before he officially became a practitioner, he would not easily contact the people in the village.
As for the issue of Deep Black Arrow...
Shen Yi casually took a dark black arrow into his hand.
[Deep Black Arrow·Level 0]
[Function: Can cause damage to first-level monsters]
[Characteristics: None]
[Durability value: 0100]
…
The durability value has indeed dropped to the lowest level.
Shen Yi felt regretful, but the next moment, he immediately upgraded the completely damaged Shenwu Arrow.
Swish——
